turns.learner: Hello! I have an English exam soon. Can we practise always, usually, sometimes and never?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Good plan for your exam. Let's start with one question: where does an adverb like "usually" go in a sentence, before or after the main verb?

Here is an example of my own, partly solved:
"My neighbour ___ walks to the park on Sundays."
I want to say this happens often but not every time, so I choose "usually". The main verb is "walks".

Your turn: write the complete sentence with "usually" in the right place. Then tell me in a few words why you put it there.
